payload.title: M1: Batch runner — compile and run Python, C, and C++ projects
payload.description: Intent: As the student, I want to submit a small multi-file project and get compiler output, program output, exit status, and timing back, so that I can run real code. Includes: runner container image (gcc, g++, python3), Node runner server, multi-file projects, stdin supplied up front, wall-clock and memory limits, output-size caps. Excludes: live interactive stdin, cloud deployment, UI. Definition of Done: all M1 stories' Gherkin specs pass against the runner in a local container.
